mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.customer_name, c.mobile, c.gender, c.age, c.source, c.status, c.intent_level, c.budget_min, c.budget_max, c.region, c.house_type, c.purpose, c.remark, c.heat_score, c.advisor_id, advisor.nickname AS advisor_name, c.manager_id, manager.nickname AS manager_name, c.latest_follow_time, c.next_follow_time FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user advisor ON c.advisor_id = advisor.id LEFT JOIN sys_user manager ON c.manager_id = manager.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
